question.prompt: A can complete a job alone in 3 days, and B can complete it alone in 6 days. How many days will they need to complete it working together? (Unit: days)

solutions.explanation: A completes \(1/3\) of the job each day, and B completes \(1/6\). Together they complete \(1/2\) each day, so they need \(1\div(1/2)=2\) days.
solutions.title: Combined daily rate
